snippet.title: Onikura - Official Demo Trailer | Latin American Games Showcase TGA Edition 2025
snippet.description:
A frantic and challenging boss rush with options to customize your play style as you progress. Defeat all enemies in your path with attacks, specials, parries, and unique abilities.
The demo for Onikura is now available. Visit Steam to add the game to your wishlist!
